facts.sentence: Jonathan Elias Mercer was born on July 14, 1980.

facts.sentence: Jonathan Elias Mercer’s gender is male.

facts.sentence: Jonathan Elias Mercer’s age at issue is 45 years old.

facts.sentence: Jonathan Elias Mercer is classified as Preferred Non-Tobacco.

facts.sentence: The initial face amount of the policy is $1,250,000.

facts.name: Planned Annual Premium

facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected is Option I (Level).

facts.name: Policy Owner Identity
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Jonathan Elias Mercer.

facts.name: Quarterly Premium Mode
facts.sentence: The premium mode for the policy is quarterly.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Spouse Relationship
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Elena Grace Mercer, who is married to the insured party.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Elena Grace Mercer receives 70% of the death benefit.

facts.name: Secondary Primary Beneficiary
facts.sentence: The second primary beneficiary is the Mercer Family Education Trust.

facts.name: Trust Death Benefit Share
facts.sentence: The Mercer Family Education Trust receives 30% of the death benefit.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Distribution
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is living descendants of the insured party, distributed per stirpes.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Rule
facts.sentence: Living descendants receive 100% of the death benefit if no primary beneficiaries survive.

facts.name: Definition of Separate Account
facts.sentence: A Separate Account is defined as the segregated asset account that supports variable investment options under this policy.

facts.name: Fixed Account Definition
facts.sentence: A Fixed Account is defined as the guaranteed interest account declared by HarborStone Advisory Life Insurance Company from time to time.

facts.name: Fixed Account Credited Rate
facts.sentence: The Fixed Account is subject to a current credited rate.

facts.name: Guaranteed Rate for Fixed Account
facts.sentence: The Fixed Account has a guaranteed minimum annual effective rate of 2.0%.

facts.name: Net Premium Definition
facts.sentence: Net Premium is defined as the premium received minus premium expense charges and any rider charges deducted at the time of receipt.

facts.name: Monthly Deduction Day Definition
facts.sentence: Monthly Deduction Day is defined as the monthly anniversary of the policy date when monthly policy charges are deducted.

facts.name: Investment Options Allocation
facts.sentence: Net premiums can be allocated among six investment options: U.S. Large Cap Index Portfolio, Managed Allocation Portfolio, Municipal Bond Portfolio, International Leaders Portfolio, ESG Select Portfolio, and Fixed Account.

facts.name: Initial U.S. Large Cap Allocation
facts.sentence: The initial allocation percentage for the U.S. Large Cap Index Portfolio is 35%.

facts.name: Initial Investment Allocation
facts.sentence: The initial allocation percentage for the Managed Allocation Portfolio is 20%.

facts.name: Initial Municipal Bond Allocation
facts.sentence: The initial allocation percentage for the Municipal Bond Portfolio is 20%.

facts.name: Initial ESG Portfolio Allocation
facts.sentence: The initial allocation percentage for the ESG Select Portfolio is 15%.

facts.name: Initial Fixed Account Allocation
facts.sentence: The initial allocation percentage for the Fixed Account is 10%.

facts.name: Transfer Initiation Methods
facts.sentence: Transfers between investment options can be initiated via secure web instruction.

facts.name: Telephone Transfer Initiation
facts.sentence: Transfers between investment options can be initiated via telephone authorization.

facts.name: Transfer Initiation Methods
facts.sentence: Transfers between investment options can be initiated via written request.

facts.name: Free Transfers Limit
facts.sentence: The first 24 transfers in each policy year are free of charge.

facts.name: Transfer Fee Limitation
facts.sentence: Additional transfers beyond the first 24 in a policy year incur a $15 administrative transfer fee.

facts.name: Minimum Sub-Account Balance Requirement
facts.sentence: A minimum remaining balance of $500 is required in any sub-account.

facts.name: Free Transfers Limit
facts.sentence: The first 24 transfers in each policy year are free.

facts.name: Transfer Fee Structure
facts.sentence: Additional transfers are subject to a $15 administrative transfer fee.

facts.name: Minimum Balance After Transfer
facts.sentence: A minimum remaining balance of $500 must remain in any sub-account following a transfer.

facts.name: Premium Expense Charge
facts.sentence: A premium expense charge of 4.50% applies to each premium payment.

facts.name: Asset-Based Charge Details
facts.sentence: An asset-based mortality and expense charge of 0.75% is applied annually and deducted daily.

facts.name: Monthly Policy Fee Charge
facts.sentence: A monthly policy fee of $12 is charged each month.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Based on Age
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is determined monthly based on attained age.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Based on Sex
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is determined monthly based on sex.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Based on Underwriting Class
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is determined monthly based on underwriting class.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is determined monthly based on net amount at risk.

facts.name: Fund Operating Expenses Range
facts.sentence: Fund operating expenses range between 0.20% and 1.05% annually depending on the portfolio.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 1
facts.sentence: The surrender charge in policy year 1 is $11,000.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 2
facts.sentence: The surrender charge in policy year 2 is $9,000.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 3
facts.sentence: The surrender charge in policy year 3 is $7,500.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Policy Year 4
facts.sentence: The surrender charge in policy year 4 is $6,000.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 5 Amount
facts.sentence: The surrender charge in policy year 5 is $4,000.

facts.name: Surrender Charge in Year 6
facts.sentence: The surrender charge in policy year 6 is $2,000.

facts.name: No Surrender Charge After Year 7
facts.sentence: The surrender charge in policy year 7 and later is $0.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Option I provides a level death benefit.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Selected
facts.sentence: Option I is currently selected as the death benefit option.

facts.name: Option I Death Benefit Rule
facts.sentence: Under Option I, the death benefit equals the face amount.

facts.name: Option I Death Benefit Adjustment
facts.sentence: Under Option I, the death benefit is adjusted for any outstanding loan.

facts.name: Option I Death Benefit Adjustment
facts.sentence: Under Option I, the death benefit is adjusted for any rider benefits then payable.

facts.name: Death Benefit Option II
facts.sentence: Option II provides a death benefit equal to the face amount plus variable account value.

facts.name: Option II Death Benefit Adjustment
facts.sentence: Under Option II, the death benefit is reduced by indebtedness.

facts.name: Death Benefit Option Changes
facts.sentence: Changes to the death benefit option can be requested after the first policy year.

facts.name: Death Benefit Change Rules
facts.sentence: Changes to the death benefit option are subject to company rules.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Requirement
facts.sentence: Increases in face amount require evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Minimum Face Amount Increase
facts.sentence: Face amount increases are subject to a minimum increase amount of $25,000.

facts.name: Face Amount Reduction Limit
facts.sentence: Decreases in face amount cannot reduce coverage below $250,000.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Benefit Acceleration
facts.sentence: The chronic illness acceleration rider allows acceleration of a portion of the death benefit.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Acceleration Trigger
facts.sentence: Acceleration under the chronic illness rider occurs when the insured is certified chronically ill under rider terms.

facts.name: No-Lapse Premium Rider Availability
facts.sentence: The no-lapse premium rider is available.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Benefit Access
facts.sentence: The Chronic Illness Acceleration Rider allows a portion of the death benefit to be accelerated if the insured is certified chronically ill under rider terms.

facts.name: No-Lapse Test Maintenance
facts.sentence: A policy remains in force through policy year 15 if the cumulative no-lapse test premium is satisfied.

facts.name: No-Win Withdrawal Policy Force
facts.sentence: A policy remains in force through policy year 15 if no withdrawals have been taken.

facts.name: Automatic Rebalancing Election
facts.sentence: Automatic portfolio rebalancing occurs at the policyholder’s election.

facts.name: Quarterly Rebalancing
facts.sentence: Rebalancing happens quarterly.

facts.name: Automatic Portfolio Rebalancing
facts.sentence: Rebalancing adjusts allocations to the most recent target percentages on file.

facts.name: Maximum Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum policy loan amount is 95% of available loan value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate is 4.75% variable.

facts.name: Loan Interest Reset
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate resets annually.

facts.name: Variable Loan Method
facts.sentence: Loaned amounts remain in the Separate Account under a variable loan method unless the Fixed Account loan option is elected.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum partial withdrawal amount is $500.

facts.name: Maximum Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum partial withdrawal amount is the account value minus three monthly deductions.

facts.name: Face Amount Reduction Under Option I

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Impact on No-Lapse Test

facts.name: Reinstatement Debt Requirement

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within two years from issue results in liability limited to premiums paid less indebtedness and withdrawals.

facts.name: Suicide Within Two Years Post-Reinstatement

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After Two Years

facts.name: Survivorship VUL Policy
facts.sentence: The policy is titled Survivorship Variable Universal Life Policy.

facts.name: Issuing Insurance Company
facts.sentence: The issuing company is TwoHarbor Legacy Life Assurance Company.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is THL-SVUL-2026-2044.

facts.name: Policy Effective Date
facts.sentence: The policy date is April 10, 2026.

facts.name: First Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The first insured is Rebecca Anne Holloway.

facts.name: Rebecca Holloway DOB
facts.sentence: Rebecca Anne Holloway's date of birth is January 22, 1972.

facts.name: Standard Non-Tobacco Classification
facts.sentence: Rebecca Anne Holloway’s classification is Standard Non-Tobacco.

facts.name: Second Insured Identified
facts.sentence: The second insured is Daniel Scott Holloway.

facts.name: Daniel Holloway DOB
facts.sentence: Daniel Scott Holloway's date of birth is August 4, 1970.

facts.name: Preferred Non-Tobacco Classification
facts.sentence: Daniel Scott Holloway’s classification is Preferred Non-Tobacco.

facts.name: Initial Face Amount
facts.sentence: The initial face amount of the policy is $2,500,000.

facts.name: Planned Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The planned annual premium is $28,000.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected is the Second-to-Die Option.

facts.name: Policy Ownership Designation
facts.sentence: The policy owner is the Holloway Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust.

facts.name: Annual Premium Mode
facts.sentence: The premium mode is Annual.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is the Holloway Dynasty Trust.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The Holloway Dynasty Trust holds 100% of the primary beneficiary share.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is the Estate of the policy owner.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The Estate of the policy owner holds 100% of the contingent beneficiary share.

facts.name: Survivorship Death Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Survivorship Death Benefit' refers to the amount payable upon the death of the second insured to die.

facts.name: Insured-Specific Charges Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Insured-Specific Charge' is defined as a cost factor determined individually for each insured based on age, sex, class, and risk factors.

facts.name: Accumulation Account Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Accumulation Account' refers to the total value of all sub-accounts and the guaranteed interest option minus any outstanding deductions.

facts.name: Trust Owner Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Trust Owner' is defined as the legal owner of this policy and the entity authorized to exercise ownership rights.

facts.name: Investment Allocation Options
facts.sentence: Net premium can be allocated among five investment options: Core Equity Strategy, Dividend Value Strategy, Intermediate Bond Strategy, Global Allocation Strategy, and Short-Term Reserve Account.

facts.name: Minimum Guaranteed Return
facts.sentence: The Guaranteed Interest Option offers a minimum rate of return of 2.25%.

facts.name: Current Core Equity Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation to the Core Equity Strategy is 25%.

facts.name: Dividend Value Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation to the Dividend Value Strategy is 25%.

facts.name: Intermediate Bond Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation to the Intermediate Bond Strategy is 20%.

facts.name: Current Global Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation to the Global Allocation Strategy is 20%.

facts.name: Guaranteed Interest Option Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation to the Guaranteed Interest Option is 10%.

facts.name: Trusted Transfer Authority
facts.sentence: Transfer requests may be submitted by the trustee of the trust.

facts.name: Authorized Transfer Submitters
facts.sentence: Transfer requests may also be submitted by an authorized registered representative.

facts.name: Market Timing Restrictions
facts.sentence: Excessive trading restrictions apply due to the company’s market timing policy.

facts.name: Premium Load Charge
facts.sentence: There is a Premium Load charged at 3.75% of each premium payment.

facts.name: Excessive Trading Restrictions
facts.sentence: Excessive trading restrictions apply under the market timing policy.

facts.name: Premium Load Charge
facts.sentence: A premium load of 3.75% applies to each premium payment.

facts.name: Mortality and Expense Charge
facts.sentence: The mortality and expense charge is 0.95% per annum.

facts.name: Daily Deduction of ME Charge
facts.sentence: The mortality and expense charge is deducted daily.

facts.name: Monthly Policy Charge
facts.sentence: A monthly policy charge of $18 is assessed.

facts.name: Joint Cost Calculation Frequency
facts.sentence: The joint cost of insurance is determined monthly.

facts.name: Joint Cost Calculation Method
facts.sentence: The joint cost of insurance uses rates applicable to both insureds.

facts.name: Joint Cost with Survivorship Risk
facts.sentence: The joint cost of insurance incorporates the survivorship risk assumption.

facts.name: Trust Certification Fee
facts.sentence: A trust certification review fee of $100 is charged for any ownership change.

facts.name: Trust Certification Fee
facts.sentence: A trust certification review fee of $100 is charged for any successor trustee certification.

facts.name: Trust Certification Review Fee
facts.sentence: A trust certification review fee of $100 is charged for any collateral assignment filing.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Period
facts.sentence: The surrender charge schedule applies during Years 1–3.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 1–3
facts.sentence: The surrender charge rate from Years 1–3 is 8%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Period (Years 4–6)
facts.sentence: The surrender charge schedule applies during Years 4–6.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 4–6
facts.sentence: The surrender charge rate from Years 4–6 is 6%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 7–8
facts.sentence: The surrender charge schedule applies during Years 7–8.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 7–8
facts.sentence: The surrender charge rate from Years 7–8 is 4%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 9–10
facts.sentence: The surrender charge schedule applies during Years 9–10.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 9–10
facts.sentence: The surrender charge rate from Years 9–10 is 2%.

facts.name: Zero Surrender Charge After Year 11
facts.sentence: The surrender charge rate from Year 11 onward is 0%.

facts.name: First Death Benefit Condition
facts.sentence: No death benefit is payable at the first death unless the First Death Rider is attached.

facts.name: Survivorship Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The Survivorship Death Benefit is payable upon proof that both insureds have died while the policy is in force.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Eligibility
facts.sentence: The face amount may be increased after the third policy year.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Requirement
facts.sentence: An increase in the face amount requires evidence of insurability on both insureds.

facts.name: Policy Split Allowance
facts.sentence: A request to split the policy into two individual policies may be allowed.

facts.name: Policy Split Requirement
facts.sentence: A Policy Split Endorsement must be attached for a policy split to occur.

facts.name: Estate Liquidity Access
facts.sentence: The Estate Liquidity Rider provides advance access to a portion of the death benefit.

facts.name: Estate Liquidity Access Trigger
facts.sentence: Advance access under the Estate Liquidity Rider occurs after the first death.

facts.name: Estate Liquidity Access Condition
facts.sentence: Access under the Estate Liquidity Rider is contingent on meeting estate tax liquidity conditions specified in the rider.

facts.name: Trust Protector Ownership Direction
facts.sentence: The Trust Protector Endorsement allows ownership direction by a named trust protector.

facts.name: Trust Protector Authority Limitation
facts.sentence: Ownership direction via the Trust Protector Endorsement is limited to investment and allocation instructions.

facts.name: Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit Rider ensures a minimum second-to-die death benefit.

facts.name: Guaranteed Min Death Benefit to Age 95
facts.sentence: The guaranteed minimum second-to-die death benefit extends to age 95.

facts.name: Guaranteed Premium Requirement
facts.sentence: The Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit Rider requires that required premiums be paid when due.

facts.name: Maximum Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: Policy loans are permitted up to 90% of the net surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The interest rate for policy loans is fixed at 5.25%.

facts.name: Loan reduces death benefit
facts.sentence: Policy loans reduce the survivorship death benefit.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Riders
facts.sentence: Policy loans may impair rider guarantees.

facts.name: Allowed Partial Surrenders
facts.sentence: Partial surrenders are allowed.

facts.name: Max Partial Surrender Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum partial surrender allowed is 90% of net surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest rate on the policy is 5.25% fixed.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Loans reduce the survivorship death benefit.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Rider Guarantees
facts.sentence: Loans may impair rider guarantees.

facts.name: Post-Year-2 Partial Surrender
facts.sentence: Partial surrenders are allowed only after policy year 2.

facts.name: Partial Surrender Minimum
facts.sentence: Minimum amount for a partial surrender is $2,500.

facts.name: Partial Surrender Reduces Face Amount
facts.sentence: Each partial surrender reduces the face amount proportionately.

facts.name: Trustee Withdrawal Certification
facts.sentence: Any withdrawal requested by the trustee must include a certification that the withdrawal is permitted under the governing trust instrument.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: This policy lapses if the accumulation account is insufficient to cover the monthly deduction.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Due to Insufficient Funds
facts.sentence: This policy lapses if the accumulation account is insufficient to cover any applicable rider charges.

facts.name: Grace Period After Notice
facts.sentence: A grace period of 62 days applies after written notice.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 3 years after lapse.

facts.name: Both Insureds Must Be Living
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available only if both insureds are living at the time of reinstatement request.

facts.name: Reinstatement Conditions
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires satisfaction of all reinstatement conditions.

facts.name: Suicide Proceeds Adjustment
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within 2 years of issue, the policy proceeds are adjusted under the survivorship suicide provision.

facts.name: Suicide After Reinstatement
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within 2 years of reinstatement, the policy proceeds are adjusted under the survivorship suicide provision.

facts.name: Contestability Period Clause
facts.sentence: Statements made for each insured may be contested during the applicable contestable period.

facts.name: Beneficiary Rights Limitation
facts.sentence: No assignee or beneficiary acquires any rights greater than those held by the policy owner.

facts.name: Issuance via Separate Account
facts.sentence: This policy is issued through TwoHarbor Separate Account C.

facts.name: Non-guaranteed investment returns
facts.sentence: Investment performance of the policy is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Policy Owner Bears Investment Risk
facts.sentence: Investment risk is borne by the policy owner.

facts.name: Prospectus Review Requirement
facts.sentence: The prospectus for the Separate Account should be read before making allocations.

facts.name: Prospectus Review Requirement
facts.sentence: The prospectus for each underlying portfolio should be read before making allocations.

facts.name: Executive VUL Policy Type
facts.sentence: The policy type is EXECUTIVE VARIABLE UNIVERSAL LIFE POLICY.

facts.name: Issuing Insurer
facts.sentence: The issuing company is SummitPeak Corporate Life Insurance Company.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is SPC-VUL-2026-3372.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: The policy date is April 10, 2026.

facts.name: Insured Party Identity
facts.sentence: The insured party is Melissa Joanne Reinhart.

facts.name: Birthdate of Insured
facts.sentence: Melissa Joanne Reinhart was born on November 9, 1978.

facts.name: Gender Identity
facts.sentence: Melissa Joanne Reinhart’s gender is Female.

facts.name: Age at Issue: 47
facts.sentence: Melissa Joanne Reinhart’s age at issue is 47.

facts.name: Preferred Executive Classification
facts.sentence: Melissa Joanne Reinhart is classified as Preferred Executive.

facts.name: Initial Face Amount
facts.sentence: The initial face amount of the policy is $1,800,000.

facts.name: Planned Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The planned annual premium is $30,000.

facts.name: Option II Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected is Option II.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation: Option II
facts.sentence: Option II provides a death benefit equal to the sum of the Face Amount and the Account Value.

facts.name: Policy Ownership
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Melissa Joanne Reinhart.

facts.name: Employer Bonus Arrangement
facts.sentence: There is an Employer Bonus Arrangement specified under Section 162 Executive Bonus.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is David Alan Reinhart, who receives 60% of the proceeds.

facts.name: Co-Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Rebecca J. Reinhart and Samuel D. Reinhart are co-primary beneficiaries sharing 40% equally.

facts.name: Estate as Contingent Beneficiary
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is the Estate of the insured party.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Payout Rule
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary receives 100% of the proceeds if no primary beneficiaries survive.

facts.name: Bonus Premium Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Bonus Premium' is defined as a premium funded directly or indirectly by the employer under the executive bonus arrangement.

facts.name: Restricted Endorsement Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Restricted Endorsement' refers to the collateral assignment and restrictive endorsement filed with SummitPeak Corporate Life Insurance Company by the employer.

facts.name: Variable Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: The 'Variable Account Value' is defined as the total value of all sub-accounts plus the fixed account minus charges and indebtedness.

facts.name: Supplemental Compensation Rider
facts.sentence: The 'Supplemental Compensation Rider' is a rider allowing the employer to pay additional scheduled premiums.

facts.name: Investment Portfolios Available
facts.sentence: Net premiums can be allocated among five investment portfolios: Aggressive Growth Portfolio, Blue Chip Dividend Portfolio, Short Duration Bond Portfolio, Asset Rotation Portfolio, and Stable Interest Option.

facts.name: Aggressive Growth Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation percentage for Aggressive Growth Portfolio is 45%.

facts.name: Blue Chip Dividend Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation percentage for Blue Chip Dividend Portfolio is 20%.

facts.name: Asset Rotation Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation percentage for Asset Rotation Portfolio is 15%.

facts.name: Short Duration Bond Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation percentage for Short Duration Bond Portfolio is 10%.

facts.name: Stable Interest Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation percentage for Stable Interest Option is 10%.

facts.name: Owner-Controlled Transfers
facts.sentence: Transfers within the policy may be initiated by the policy owner.

facts.name: Transfer Restrictions During Endorsement
facts.sentence: During the time a Restricted Endorsement remains in effect, only transfer requests that do not violate the employer's rights will be honored.

facts.name: Premium Load Rate
facts.sentence: The premium load charged is 4.25%.

facts.name: Daily Mortality & Expense Charge Rate
facts.sentence: The daily mortality and expense charge rate is 0.85% per annum.

facts.name: Monthly Administrative Charge
facts.sentence: The monthly administrative charge is applicable but its exact amount is not specified.

facts.name: Premium Load Rate
facts.sentence: Premium load is 4.25%.

facts.name: Daily M&E Charge Rate
facts.sentence: Daily management and expense charge is 0.85% annually.

facts.name: Monthly Administrative Charge
facts.sentence: Monthly administrative charge is $10.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: Cost of insurance is a monthly charge based on the net amount at risk.

facts.name: Annual Fund Expenses Range
facts.sentence: Fund expenses range from 0.30% to 1.10% annually.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 1
facts.sentence: Surrender charge is 9% in year 1.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 2
facts.sentence: Surrender charge is 8% in year 2.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 3
facts.sentence: Surrender charge is 7% in year 3.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 4
facts.sentence: Surrender charge is 5% in year 4.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 5
facts.sentence: Surrender charge is 4% in year 5.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Year 6
facts.sentence: Surrender charge is 2% in year 6.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Exemption After Year 7
facts.sentence: Surrender charge is 0% in year 7 and beyond.

facts.name: Face Plus Selected
facts.sentence: Option II – Face Plus Account Value is currently selected.

facts.name: Rider Termination Continuity
facts.sentence: If the Supplemental Compensation Rider terminates, the policy remains in force under its own values and charges.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Requirement
facts.sentence: Face amount increase requests made after issue require evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Approval
facts.sentence: Face amount increase requests made after issue require approval.

facts.name: Restricted Endorsement Impact
facts.sentence: Any restricted endorsement does not change the amount of death benefit payable.

facts.name: Restricted Endorsement Impact
facts.sentence: Any restricted endorsement may affect distribution rights after payment.

facts.name: Executive Disability Waiver Rider
facts.sentence: Executive Disability Waiver Rider exists as a special rider.

facts.name: Employer Recovery Endorsement
facts.sentence: Employer Recovery Endorsement exists as a special endorsement.

facts.name: Dollar-Cost Averaging Program
facts.sentence: Dollar-Cost Averaging Program exists as a special program.

facts.name: Loan Limit Based on Surrender Value
facts.sentence: Policy loans can be up to 92% of surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Policy loans carry a fixed rate of 5.0%.

facts.name: Loan Consent Requirement
facts.sentence: Policy loans require consent of any assignee on file.

facts.name: Minimum Partial Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals must be at least $1,000.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Fee
facts.sentence: Processing fee for partial withdrawals is $35.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawals Reduce Face Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals reduce the face amount proportionally.

facts.name: Assignment Priority Over Beneficiary
facts.sentence: A collateral assignment by the employer takes priority over a later beneficiary designation.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: This policy will lapse if the account value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions after the grace period.

facts.name: Lapse Notice Timing
facts.sentence: Notice of pending lapse will be mailed to the owner at least 30 days before lapse.

facts.name: Lapse Notice Procedure
facts.sentence: Notice of pending lapse will be mailed to any assignee of record at least 30 days before lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 5 years requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 5 years requires payment of overdue deductions with interest.

facts.name: Reinstatement Endorsement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 5 years requires restoration of any required endorsements.

facts.name: Assignee Timing Requirement
facts.sentence: An assignee of record must exist at least 30 days before lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Insurability Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 5 years requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 5 years requires payment of overdue deductions with interest.

facts.name: Restoration of Endorsements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 5 years requires restoration of any required endorsements.

facts.name: Suicide Liability Limitation
facts.sentence: During the first 2 policy years, liability for suicide is limited to premiums paid minus withdrawals.

facts.name: Suicide Liability After Reinstatement
facts.sentence: Within 2 years after reinstatement, liability for suicide is limited to premiums paid minus withdrawals.

facts.name: Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: If age is misstated, benefits and charges will be adjusted accordingly.

facts.name: Misstatement of Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: If sex is misstated, benefits and charges will be adjusted accordingly.

facts.name: Smoking Status Misstatement
facts.sentence: If smoking status is misstated, benefits and charges will be adjusted accordingly.

facts.name: No Investment Guarantee
facts.sentence: This policy does not guarantee investment results in any variable portfolio.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Entity
facts.sentence: This policy is issued through SummitPeak Separate Account One.

facts.name: Access via Prospectus
facts.sentence: Variable portfolios are available only through a prospectus.

facts.name: No Portfolio Performance Guarantee
facts.sentence: Neither the employer nor the insurer guarantees portfolio performance.

facts.name: Policy Issuance by SummitPeak
facts.sentence: SummitPeak Corporate Life Insurance Company executed this policy.

facts.name: Company Headquarters Location
facts.sentence: SummitPeak Corporate Life Insurance Company is located in Chicago, Illinois.

facts.name: Policy Execution by Senior VP
facts.sentence: A Senior Vice President of SummitPeak Corporate Life Insurance Company executed this policy.

facts.name: Insurer Identification
facts.sentence: The insurer issuing the Variable Universal Life Insurance Policy is Cedar Valley National Life Insurance Company.

facts.name: Policy Identification Number
facts.sentence: The policy number assigned to this contract is CVN-VUL-2026-4419.

facts.name: Effective Policy Start Date
facts.sentence: The effective date of the policy is April 10, 2026.

facts.name: Insured Party Name
facts.sentence: The insured party's name is Olivia Renee Chambers.

facts.name: Birth Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: Olivia Renee Chambers was born on May 18, 1986.

facts.name: Gender Identification
facts.sentence: Olivia Renee Chambers identifies as female.

facts.name: Age at Issue: 39
facts.sentence: At the time of issue, Olivia Renee Chambers was 39 years old.

facts.name: Underwriting Classification: Standard Plus
facts.sentence: Olivia Renee Chambers is classified as 'Standard Plus' in terms of underwriting classification.

facts.name: Initial Face Amount
facts.sentence: The initial face amount of the policy is $750,000.

facts.name: Planned Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The planned annual premium for this policy is $9,600.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Option
facts.sentence: The selected death benefit option is Option I, which provides a level death benefit.

facts.name: Return of Premium Feature
facts.sentence: The Return of Premium feature has been elected on this policy.

facts.name: No-Lapse Duration Condition
facts.sentence: The no-lapse duration extends to age 90, contingent upon meeting the qualification test.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary named in the policy is Marcus Leonard Chambers, who receives 100% of the death benefit.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Distribution
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiaries are children born of the insured, each receiving an equal share of the death benefit.

facts.name: Return of Premium Base Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Return of Premium Base' refers to the cumulative specified premiums paid minus cumulative withdrawals and rider charges excluded by Cedar Valley National Life Insurance Company.

facts.name: Qualification Premium Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Qualification Premium' refers to the premium amount required under the no-lapse test as displayed on the policy data page.

facts.name: Protected Death Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Protected Death Benefit' refers to the minimum death benefit that is maintained while the no-lapse qualification condition remains satisfied.

facts.name: Segmented Surrender Charge Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Segmented Surrender Charge' refers to a surrender charge applied according to premium layers rather than solely by policy year.

facts.name: Investment Allocation Options
facts.sentence: Net premiums from this policy may be allocated among five investment options: U.S. Equity Opportunities Fund, Balanced Income Fund, Inflation Managed Bond Fund, Strategic Allocation Fund, and Fixed Interest Option.

facts.name: Current Investment Allocation
facts.sentence: As of the current allocation, 30% of assets are invested in the U.S. Equity Opportunities Fund.

facts.name: Current Investment Allocation
facts.sentence: As of the current allocation, 30% of assets are invested in the Balanced Income Fund.

facts.name: Current Investment Allocation
facts.sentence: As of the current allocation, 20% of assets are invested in the Inflation Managed Bond Fund.

facts.name: Current Investment Allocation
facts.sentence: As of the current allocation, 10% of assets are invested in the Strategic Allocation Fund.

facts.name: Fixed Interest Allocation
facts.sentence: As of the current allocation, 10% of assets are invested in the Fixed Interest Option.

facts.name: Monthly Rebalancing Option
facts.sentence: The policyholder may elect monthly automatic rebalancing of investments at no additional cost.

facts.name: Premium Load Application
facts.sentence: A premium load of 5.50% applies to incoming premiums.

facts.name: Mortality & Expense Charge Details
facts.sentence: An Mortality & Expense (M&E) charge of 0.70% per annum is assessed and deducted daily.

facts.name: Monthly Policy Charge
facts.sentence: A fixed monthly policy charge of $14 is imposed on the policy.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: The Cost of Insurance charge is calculated monthly and depends on the insured’s age, gender, underwriting class, and net amount at risk.

facts.name: Fund Expense Rate
facts.sentence: Fund expenses are charged at a rate of 0.25%.

facts.name: LY Policy Charge
facts.sentence: The LY policy charge is $14.

facts.name: Monthly Cost Calculation
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is calculated monthly.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Based on Age
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is based on age.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Based on Sex
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is based on sex.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Based on Class
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is based on class.

facts.name: Cost Based on Net Amount at Risk
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is based on net amount at risk.

facts.name: Annual Fund Expenses Range
facts.sentence: Fund expenses range from 0.25% to 0.95% annually.

facts.name: Segmented Surrender Charge Per Payment
facts.sentence: A segmented surrender charge applies to each premium payment.

facts.name: Segmented Surrender Charge Schedule
facts.sentence: The segmented surrender charge follows a 7-year declining schedule.

facts.name: Initial Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: The initial segmented surrender charge rate is 7%.

facts.name: Final Surrender Charge Rate Zero
facts.sentence: The final segmented surrender charge rate is 0%.

facts.name: Current Death Benefit Selection
facts.sentence: Option I – Level Death Benefit is currently selected.

facts.name: Election of Option II After Year 5
facts.sentence: Option II may be elected after policy year 5.

facts.name: Option II Election Rules
facts.sentence: Option II election is subject to the insurer’s rules.

facts.name: No-Lapse Qualification Loss
facts.sentence: If the no-lapse qualification is lost, the policy continues as a standard variable universal life policy.

facts.name: Policy Continuation Based on Values
facts.sentence: Available values determine the continuation of the policy under standard variable universal life terms.

facts.name: Child Level Term Rider Availability
facts.sentence: Child Level Term Rider is offered as a rider.

facts.name: Overloan Protection Rider Offered
facts.sentence: Overloan Protection Rider is offered as a rider.

facts.name: Persistency Credit Start
facts.sentence: Premium Persistency Credit begins in policy year 11.

facts.name: Max Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum policy loans equal 90% of the surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Policy loans carry a fixed interest rate of 5.25%.

facts.name: Loan Fund Allocation Priority
facts.sentence: Loaned amounts are transferred first from the Fixed Interest Option.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Minimum partial withdrawals are $750.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Limits
facts.sentence: Maximum partial withdrawals are limited to the account value minus the surrender charge and two monthly deductions.

facts.name: Withdrawal Reduces Return Base
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals reduce the Return of Premium Base.

facts.name: Withdrawal Impact on Persistency Credit
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals made during the first 10 policy years may terminate the persistency credit.

facts.name: Early Withdrawal Impact on Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals made during the first 10 policy years may reduce protected death benefit coverage.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Trigger
facts.sentence: Lapse occurs when the account value is insufficient to cover deductions.

facts.name: No-Lapse Qualification Condition
facts.sentence: Lapse only occurs if the no-lapse qualification is not in effect.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: A grace period of 61 days applies after notice is mailed.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires payment of overdue amounts.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires payment of 6% annual interest on overdue amounts.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide exclusion limits payout to premiums paid less withdrawals if suicide occurs within 2 years.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable after 2 years.

facts.name: Fixed Interest Rate
facts.sentence: This policy has a 6% annual interest rate.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion
facts.sentence: Suicide is excluded under Section 8.1.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Terms
facts.sentence: The suicide exclusion applies only to premiums paid minus withdrawals if death occurs within two years.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After Two Years
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable after two years during the insured's lifetime.

facts.name: Exception to Incontestability
facts.sentence: The exception to the incontestability clause is nonpayment of premiums.

facts.name: Owner Bears Investment Risk
facts.sentence: The owner bears all investment risk for variable accounts.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Vehicle
facts.sentence: This policy is issued through Cedar Valley Variable Account B.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Account Values
facts.sentence: Account values are not guaranteed except for the Fixed Interest Option.

facts.name: Read Prospectus Before Investing
facts.sentence: Investors should read all prospectus materials before investing.

facts.name: Private Placement VUL Policy
facts.sentence: The policy type is a Private Placement Variable Universal Life Policy.

facts.name: Issuing Insurer Identification
facts.sentence: The issuing company is Meridian Crest Insurance International.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is MCI-PPVUL-2026-5086.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: The policy was issued on April 10, 2026.

facts.name: Insured Party Identity
facts.sentence: The insured party's name is Christopher James Alden.

facts.name: Insured Party Birth Date
facts.sentence: Christopher James Alden was born on February 1, 1969.

facts.name: Insured Gender Confirmation
facts.sentence: Christopher James Alden is male.

facts.name: Age at Policy Issuance
facts.sentence: Christopher James Alden was age 57 when the policy was issued.

facts.name: Preferred Private Client Classification
facts.sentence: Christopher James Alden is classified as a Preferred Private Client.

facts.name: Initial Face Amount Set
facts.sentence: The initial face amount of the policy is $5,000,000.

facts.name: Minimum Initial Premium Requirement
facts.sentence: The minimum initial premium required is $250,000.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Option
facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected is Option I (Level).

facts.name: Policy Ownership Structure
facts.sentence: The policy owner is the Alden Family Limited Partnership.

facts.name: Qualified Purchaser Requirement
facts.sentence: Qualified purchaser status is required for this policy.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is the Alden Family Irrevocable Trust.

facts.name: Trust Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The Alden Family Irrevocable Trust holds 100% of the primary beneficiary share.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Distribution
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is the issue of the insured, distributed per stirpes.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Distribution
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary receives 100% of the proceeds under the contingency clause.

facts.name: Private Placement Fund Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Private Placement Fund' refers to an underlying insurance-dedicated fund accessible exclusively to qualified purchasers and accredited investors via this policy.

facts.name: Investor Eligibility Event Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Investor Eligibility Event' occurs when the owner or controlling person fails to meet an eligibility requirement.

facts.name: Insurance-Dedicated Asset Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Insurance-Dedicated Asset' is defined as an asset held in accordance with diversification and investor control rules applicable to this policy.

facts.name: Advisor Authorization Document
facts.sentence: An 'Investment Advisor Direction Letter' is a file specifying the advisor authorized to provide model allocation instructions.

facts.name: Premium Investment Options
facts.sentence: Net premiums can be allocated among five investment options: Multi-Strategy, Credit Opportunities, Global Equity, Treasury Reserve, and Fixed Account.

facts.name: Current Multi-Strategy Allocation
facts.sentence: The current allocation percentage for Multi-Strategy is 35%.

facts.name: Current Credit Opportunities Allocation
facts.sentence: The current allocation percentage for Credit Opportunities is 25%.

facts.name: Global Equity Allocation
facts.sentence: The current allocation percentage for Global Equity is 25%.

facts.name: Current Treasury Reserve Allocation
facts.sentence: The current allocation percentage for Treasury Reserve is 10%.

facts.name: Fixed Account Allocation
facts.sentence: The current allocation percentage for Fixed Account is 5%.

facts.name: Transfer Timing Restriction
facts.sentence: Transfers between investment options are allowed only on monthly valuation dates.

facts.name: Insurer Allocation Rejection Right
facts.sentence: The insurer reserves the right to reject any allocation instruction that causes investor control concerns.

facts.name: Allocation Rejection Due to Diversification Violation
facts.sentence: The insurer reserves the right to reject any allocation instruction that violates diversification rules.

facts.name: Insurer Allocation Rejection Right
facts.sentence: The insurer reserves the right to reject any allocation instruction that results in noncompliance with applicable private placement requirements.

facts.name: Premium Load Fee Rate
facts.sentence: The premium load fee is 1.00%.

facts.name: Annual M&E Charge Rate
facts.sentence: The Mortality & Expense (M&E) charge is 0.40% annually.

facts.name: Daily M&E Charge Deduction
facts.sentence: The M&E charge is deducted daily from the policy account.

facts.name: Monthly Policy Charge
facts.sentence: The monthly policy charge is $20.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is calculated monthly based on the net amount at risk.

facts.name: M&E Charge Details
facts.sentence: The annual management and evaluation charge is 0.40%, deducted daily.

facts.name: Monthly Policy Charge
facts.sentence: The monthly policy charge is $20.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Calculation
facts.sentence: The cost of insurance is calculated monthly based on the net amount at risk.

facts.name: Advisory Platform Fee Details
facts.sentence: The advisory platform fee is 0.35% annually, charged monthly to the account value.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 1–2
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 2% applies in years 1 and 2.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 3–4
facts.sentence: A surrender charge of 1% applies in years 3 and 4.

facts.name: No Surrender Charge After Year 5
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies in year 5 and beyond.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Selected
facts.sentence: Option I – Level Death Benefit is currently selected.

facts.name: Option II Consent Requirement
facts.sentence: Option II may be elected only with the insurer's consent.

facts.name: Option II Tax Dependency
facts.sentence: Option II election is subject to current tax laws.

facts.name: Option II Election Constraints
facts.sentence: Option II election is subject to current securities regulations.

facts.name: Option II Election Constraints
facts.sentence: Option II election is subject to current administrative rules.

facts.name: Face Amount Reduction Constraints
facts.sentence: Face amount reductions requested by the owner are subject to premium corridor requirements.

facts.name: Face Amount Reduction Compliance
facts.sentence: Face amount reductions requested by the owner are subject to tax compliance requirements.

facts.name: Policy Amendment Requirement
facts.sentence: The insurer may require a policy amendment to maintain intended life insurance qualification under applicable tax law.

facts.name: Open Architecture Endorsement
facts.sentence: An Open Architecture Endorsement is included in the policy.

facts.name: Family Office Reporting Service
facts.sentence: A Family Office Reporting Service is available under the policy.

facts.name: Tax Compliance Provision
facts.sentence: A Tax Compliance Provision is part of the policy.

facts.name: Maximum Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: Policy loans can be up to 90% of the surrender value.

facts.name: Policy Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The interest rate for policy loans is variable at 4.50%.

facts.name: Loan Asset Source Priority
facts.sentence: Loaned assets are drawn first from the Treasury Reserve Account unless otherwise permitted.

facts.name: Minimum Partial Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals have a minimum threshold of $10,000.

facts.name: No Fee for Partial Withdrawals
facts.sentence: There is no processing fee for partial withdrawals.

facts.name: Withdrawal Suspension Due to Valuation Delays
facts.sentence: Withdrawals may be suspended due to illiquid fund valuation delays.

facts.name: Investor Eligibility Restriction
facts.sentence: If an Investor Eligibility Event occurs, the insurer may restrict new premium payments.

facts.name: Investor Eligibility Restriction
facts.sentence: If an Investor Eligibility Event occurs, the insurer may restrict transfer rights.

facts.name: Investor Eligibility Event Action
facts.sentence: If an Investor Eligibility Event occurs, the insurer may require reallocation to permitted options.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: Lapse occurs when the account value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions.

facts.name: Grace Period Before Lapse
facts.sentence: After notice, a 60-day grace period is provided before lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Proof Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within two years requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Compliance Review
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within two years requires a compliance review for eligibility.

facts.name: Reinstatement Compliance Review
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within two years requires compliance review for tax requirements.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: Suicide benefits are limited to premiums paid minus withdrawals if death occurs within two years.

facts.name: Owner Bears Investment Risk
facts.sentence: The owner bears all investment risk in private funds.

facts.name: Liquidity Limitations on Fund Redemptions
facts.sentence: Redemptions from certain funds may face liquidity limitations.

facts.name: IDE Time Restriction
facts.sentence: IDE applies only when premiums are paid and withdrawals occur within two years.

facts.name: Owner Bears Investment Risk
facts.sentence: The owner bears all investment risk in private funds.

facts.name: Redemption Delay Due to Lock-Up
facts.sentence: Redemptions from certain funds may be delayed due to underlying fund lock-up restrictions.

facts.name: Redemption Delays Due to Gate Restrictions
facts.sentence: Redemptions from certain funds may be delayed due to underlying fund gate restrictions.

facts.name: Redemption Delays Due to Valuation
facts.sentence: Redemptions from certain funds may be delayed due to underlying fund valuation restrictions.
